name: zdecision
description: Inline current-task opt-in Recall handoff; Candidate refresh remains explicit

interface.shortDescription: Current-task Recall handoff and explicit Candidate refresh
interface.longDescription: A trusted confirmation card click authorizes current-task Recall; the App prepares one frozen handoff for the next native message to classify and apply. Formal Decision Recall may report unavailable until the production provider is ready. Candidate refresh remains explicit. Installing the Plugin does not automatically recall Decisions.
defaultPrompt: 使用 ZDecision Recall：显示确认卡，点击启用后在下一条原生消息中应用完整决策交付
